metadata.expected: All declarations, signatures, COM binding endpoints, attributes, parameter identities, marshaling and necessary resources are source-recoverable. 17 tables; 2055 rows.
metadata.actual: Two independent reads with SRM, decoding type refs inside method/field/property/member-ref signatures. Definition tokens, ownership, flags, signatures, names, method/param order and tokens, constant parents, custom-attribute constructors and blobs, property accessors, decoded MethodImpl endpoint pairs including tokens and type identities, FieldMarshal parents and all descriptor bytes matched. 2055 normalized records in each TSV plus 17 count lines. Every populated table represented exactly once per row. RID/order changes for TypeRef, MemberRef, CustomAttribute normalized by resolved record identity and multiplicity. Module MVID separately recorded.

checks.body_eh: 290/290 MethodDef RVA 0, runtime/internalcall; no IL blocks, exception regions, managed entrypoint or executable method-body code to recover.

com_marshal.sources: 135 explicit .override directives; public key and COM Guid, TypeLib and interface declarations or attributes from editable IL. Helpers rebuild explicit empty return Params, unnamed parameters, retained reference and omitted SAFEARRAY typename. Validated by output table coverage.

resource.independent: Independent PE resource-tree walk, raw payload SHA, language, reserved field and code page all match. Built from fixed version tree + string values + translation fields in version.json. Managed resources directory = (0,0) and no ManifestResource, Event or ImplMap rows. Single mscorlib reference, no XAML/BAML/WPF controls, events or bindings.

checks.build_input_review: Reviewed build.py and image.py. Reads editable IL and version.json, creates version.res and assembly.il, invokes local ILAsm; finalizer only reads ILAsm output and active source annotations to rewrite its metadata, resource codepage, timestamp and MVID. No original file, original metadata/table/heap bytes, raw resource, image layout, previous binary, certificate, proof.json, listing files, ZIP manifest or expected hash control the build. Literal identities, public key, attributes, marshal values and version values are transcribed original declarations or data. The finalizer serializes new ILAsm table rows; its rewrites do not import original rows.
checks.production_comparison: Recomputed proof.json byte-identical to bundled proof.json; Microsoft SRM and independent PE/resource comparisons were written by this reviewer. Bundled listing-check.json is producer evidence.

negative_binding.change: Remove only IComponentVersionString::get_VersionString override in independent four-input copy. No proof files, manifest or prebuilt objects present in either control.
negative_binding.expected: Other declarations and version resource hold; MethodImpl loses precisely this endpoint pair.

negative_resource.change: Change only JSON Comments value from one space to R.
negative_resource.expected: Resource payload hash changes; CLI semantic rows, resource size/identity and codepage hold.

signature_and_build_exceptions.platform: Both PE32, I386, ILONLY, AnyCPU flags and public key unchanged. Original CLR forced signature check passed; Windows reported valid Authenticode, signer Aspen Technology, Inc. Build retained identity/public key and 128 zero bytes for strong name; CLR force verification false, Authenticode NotSigned. Original COFF timestamp 1442379163 -> 0; PE checksum 0xd690 -> 0; different MVID, reference/attribute order, metadata heaps, section virtual lengths. See observations.json and identity.json. Original signatures are not regenerated. Host load/trust consequences are outside this static finding.

historical_scope.interpretation: v2 exact reused the original metadata segment. Its 290/290 does not establish C# candidate MethodImpl, marshal or full method block coverage. Historical C# candidate fef9eba5…: 143 equal, 124 different, 23 unique on each side. No historical decision was used to assign the fresh outcome.
